content.short: A video and live commerce platform that converts visitors into buyers more effectively.
content.description: Meloot is a social commerce platform that runs on the meloot token (LADA). We are a video and live commerce platform that converts visitors into buyers more effectively than any other e-commerce platform out there. You can think of us as a combination of TikTok and Amazon, combining TikTok’s user interface with Amazon’s e-commerce capabilities - connecting people with products they like through videos and live streams. Meloot token (LADA) powers the first ecosystem of social e-commerce on Cardano.
